question: Lokesh travels from City A to City B. If Lokesh drives his car at 3/4 of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 24 minutes late.Find the time (in minutes) that Lokesh would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio = 3 : 4 (New : Normal)

Time ratio = 4 : 3 (New : Normal) [Since distance is constant]

Difference in time ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 part.

1 part = 24 minutes.

Normal time = 3 parts = 3 × 24 = 72 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 72 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New speed = 3/4 of normal speed.

Time delayed = 24 minutes.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
• 
 
 
 City A
 
 
 City B
 
 

 

 Normal Speed = S | Time = T
 
 

 

 New Speed = 3/4 S | Time = T + 24
 
 Distance is Constant

**Calculations:**

Let the normal speed be S and normal time be T.

⇒ Normal distance = S × T

⇒ New speed = 3S / 4

⇒ New time = T + 24

Since the distance between City A and City B is constant:

⇒ S × T = (3S / 4) × (T + 24)

⇒ T = 3/4 × (T + 24)

⇒ 4T = 3(T + 24)

⇒ 4T = 3T + 72

⇒ 4T − 3T = 72

⇒ T = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation of Speed and Time

When the distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional (S ∝ 1/T). If the ratio of speeds is a : b, then the ratio of the corresponding times will be b : a.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

When an object travels two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the Average Speed over the entire journey is given by (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

If two bodies are moving in the same direction, their relative speed is S₁ − S₂. If they are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed is S₁ + S₂.
